component.name: Ophion
component.summary: Connection manager for SSH, SFTP, FTP and RDP

description.p: Ophion keeps SSH, SFTP, FTP/FTPS and RDP hosts in groups, opens SSH sessions in built-in terminals, transfers files in a two-pane browser and shows Windows desktops through FreeRDP. Passwords are kept in an encrypted store or the desktop keyring, never in plain files.
Ophion was called SSH Manager before; its hosts, settings and saved passwords move over on the first start.
